_readme: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for every company fact used anywhere on the site. A number is defined once here and never diverges between pages. Every '[[TODO: ...]]' value must be replaced with a verified figure from internal sources before launch — an empty marker is correct, an invented number is a failure. '_comment' keys describe what to supply and in what unit; they are ignored by the templates. Values marked 'from brief' came from the project brief and should still be confirmed.
